metadata.title: PCEM_CriticalFacilities
metadata.description: This Critical Facility Inventory (CFI) helps Pinellas County Emergency Management communicate with service providers (e.g., electricity, gas, water, telecom, debris management) which facilities are highest priority for restoration during a disaster event. The CFI is updated annually by the County and then distributed to municipality emergency management coordinators, county departments, and other community partners for review. The data contained herein is offered “as is,” with no claim or warranty as to its accuracy or completeness. The data is for reference only and should not be considered to be of survey precision. DATA STEWARD: Pinellas County Emergency Management (727)464-3800 ema@pinellas.gov Feature Dataset: EmergencyManagement Feature Class: PCEM_CriticalFacilities

category_metadata.itemDescription: This Critical Facility Inventory (CFI) helps Pinellas County Emergency Management communicate with service providers (e.g., electricity, gas, water, telecom, debris management) which facilities are highest priority for restoration during a disaster event.
